title: dendranthema coreanum subsp. littorale
intro: Dendranthema coreanum subsp. littorale, commonly known as Korean chrysanthemum, is a plant species within the daisy family that is traditionally used in Asian medicine. Research has shown that Korean chrysanthemum has various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving sleep, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which have been found to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anti-oxidative effects. The bioactive constituents of Korean chrysanthemum, such as 11,12-dihydro-11α-hydroxy-costunolide, have been identified as key compounds responsible for its medicinal properties.
